purpose: Discover the current US-traded V6.8 candidate universe without carrying historical CRSP membership forward.

exact_downstream_rules: 60-session median dollar volume at least USD 5 million
one largest eligible security line per issuer

lseg_discovery.filter: ExchangeCountry eq 'USA' and AssetState eq 'AC' and IsExchangeTradable eq true and Currency eq 'USD' and MktCapIssueUsd ge 300000000 and PriceClose ge 5 and IsPrimaryIssueRIC eq true and RCSAssetCategoryLeaf in ('Ordinary Share' 'Fully Paid Ordinary Share' 'American Depository Receipt')

identity_policy.one_line_rule: largest issue market capitalization, then average volume, then RIC
